environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate with the same container image. The PostgreSQL RDS instance connection is made through RDS Proxy using IAM database authentication. The database role 'pipeline_ro_svc' is configured at the RDS cluster level with a restricted grant set applied via a custom parameter group init script that runs on instance bootstrap. The role has been granted only SELECT on the build_annotations table and USAGE on the public schema; no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE privileges exist for this role on any table. The pg_hba.conf equivalent (rds.force_ssl=1 with certificate pinning) ensures no alternate connection path. Note: the application code still attempts INSERT operations but they fail with 'ERROR: permission denied for table build_annotations' at the database layer. Additionally, a VPC endpoint policy restricts the RDS proxy to accept connections only from the specific ECS task security group.

config.db_grants: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO pipeline_ro_svc; GRANT SELECT ON build_annotations TO pipeline_ro_svc;
config.db_auth: IAM database authentication via RDS Proxy (token-based, no static password)
config.rds_proxy: connection pinning with IAM auth, TLS required
config.vpc_endpoint_policy: restrict source to ECS task SG sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f
config.network: internal VPC, accessible to all developer workstations
